name: L3Harris Power Paragon
old_description: L3Harris Power Paragon designs and manufactures engineered power distribution solutions. Specialty is custom switchgear – including low-, medium-, and high-voltage switchgear, DC power systems and automated transfer switchgear – for commercial, utility and government power systems.
about:
L3Harris Power Paragon is based in Anaheim, California, and operates as part of L3Harris Technologies, a major aerospace and defense contractor. The unit specializes in engineered power distribution solutions, though its specific founding year and ownership details are not disclosed in public records.

The company designs and manufactures custom switchgear spanning low-, medium-, and high-voltage ratings, as well as DC power systems and automated transfer switchgear. Its offerings include power distribution control centers, automatic transfer switchgear for paralleling applications, and DC switchgear and bus systems. Information on facility square footage, employee count, or production volumes is not available.

Power Paragon’s customer base spans commercial construction, utility and power generation, government and military agencies, and data center operators. These industries depend on the company’s tailored switchgear for reliable power distribution and control in mission-critical environments.
